name: Coldraith
description: A wizard who halted the Golthonor Torrent to hoard water and blue mana; killed by Caliphear.

description_citations.text: "Nightmare (comic)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caliphear tortures a captive Devouring Deep until Altair stops her; it reveals it serves Coldraith.
timeline.quote: The Devouring Deep confesses to serve the wizard Coldraith of Golthonor .

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Battling Coldraith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Coldraith's Keep Caliphear catapults Altair over the wall; Altair destroys the Wall of Brambles with Swords to Plowshares and the Healer's army fights the Brass Men.
timeline.quote: In order to get over the wall, Caliphear catapults Altair over the wall.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Battling Coldraith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Coldraith casts Tranquility, freeing Altair from his bindings and revealing him as a mighty Planeswalker; Caliphear kills the vulnerable Coldraith.
timeline.quote: he is revealed to be a mighty Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Battling Coldraith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Her onslaught kills the vulnerable wizard.
relations.quote: With the death of the wizard, his spells are broken
